fieldValues.title: Epic
fieldValues.theory: An epic is tracked work that implements remedies, answers problems and serves an objective. An epic becomes a working group only when chartered, on a trigger: a steady ready queue that needs delegated merges.
fieldValues.practice:
- Type `programme/epic` (issue_ref), linked by `implements`, `answers` and `serves`.
- 12 epic records: 6 serve a ranked objective, 6 are parked.
- Only Third-party ready (`8cbb562f`, semanticops.com#31) carries the whole chain from persona to epic.
gaps: Most epics have no remedy or problem link.
Epic `answers` and `implements` edges point at suggestion-layer problems, not their affirmed forks.
open_questions: Must an epic implement a remedy before it can serve an objective?
fieldValues.test: Stage 7: 2 passing; pending: epic is a working group; remedy before serving an objective.
